rarities.name: Common
rarities.rule: The base of any build. 6 levels, with milestones at Lv3 and Lv5.

rarities.name: Rare
rarities.rule: Stronger, or more specific. 6 levels. Cross-family synergies are rare or epic.

rarities.name: Epic
rarities.rule: One unique effect per family. 4 levels. At most 2 per offer.

rarities.name: Legendary
rarities.rule: Defines the build, and usually has a condition. 3 levels. Appears only with 3+ skills of its family. At most 1 per offer.

families.name: Rust
families.idea: A poison that only stacks. It never flakes away.

families.name: Tesla
families.idea: Electric discharges, arcs, and a shock when you dodge

families.name: Salvage
families.idea: A machine patching itself from scrap

families.name: Escapement
families.idea: Critical hits, accuracy, and tempo for extra actions

families.name: Rivet
families.idea: Defense, shields, and damage that scales with Defense

families.name: Automata
families.idea: Wind-up helpers that fight beside you

skills.name: Acid Drop
skills.desc: Each hit applies {v} rust.
skills.m5: you start each fight with 4 rust on the enemy

upgradeEffects.text: The weld leaves 3 rust on the enemy at the start of a fight.
A second weld. The first effect holds, and attacks deal +3%.

skills.name: Mordant
skills.desc: Each point of rust removes {v} Defense from the enemy (max 30).

skills.name: Splash
skills.desc: You start each fight by applying {v} rust.

skills.name: Acid Rain
skills.desc: Every 3 turns, apply {v} rust.

skills.name: Deep Corrosion
skills.desc: Enemies with 16+ rust take +{p} damage from everything.

skills.name: Caked Rust
skills.desc: Rust deals +{p} damage. The coat never flakes off.

skills.name: Rust Plague
skills.desc: Condition: 4+ Rust skills. At 28+ rust, rust deals +{p} damage. Stacks never flake away.

skills.name: Steam Jet
skills.desc: Each hit has a {p} chance to scald (3 turns).

upgradeEffects.text: The jet runs hotter. Scald and other damage over time deal +8%.
A second weld. The first effect holds, and attacks deal +3%.

skills.name: Relief Valve
skills.desc: Every 4 turns, deal {p} of your attack as steam and scald.

skills.name: Fog Curtain
skills.desc: +{p} Evasion.

skills.name: Boiling Point
skills.desc: Scalded enemies have -{p} Accuracy.

skills.name: Overpressure
skills.desc: Scalded enemies take +{p} damage from everything.

skills.name: Red-Hot Boiler
skills.desc: Scald deals +{p} damage.

skills.name: Geyser
skills.desc: Every 5 turns a geyser deals {p} of your attack and ignores Defense.

skills.name: Reserve Boiler
skills.desc: Once per fight, when you fall you restart with {p} HP.

skills.name: Boiler Heart
skills.desc: Condition: 4+ Steam skills. Scald never goes out, and deals +{p} damage for each turn the enemy has been scalded (max 20).

skills.name: Spark
skills.desc: Each hit has a {p} chance to fire a discharge (100% of attack).
skills.m5: your first hit each fight always discharges

skills.name: Short Circuit
skills.desc: Each discharge has a {p} chance to stun for 1 turn.

skills.name: Lightning Rod
skills.desc: Whenever you dodge, fire a discharge for {p} of your attack.

skills.name: Tesla Coil
skills.desc: Every 5 turns, fire 3 discharges of {p} attack.

skills.name: Overload
skills.desc: Discharges deal +{p} damage.

skills.name: Chain Arc
skills.desc: Each discharge has a {p} chance to repeat.

skills.name: Living Arc
skills.desc: Condition: after 8 discharges in a fight, each hit also fires a discharge of {p} attack.

skills.name: Extra Plating
skills.desc: +{p} max HP (on top of the base).

skills.name: Riveted Plate
skills.desc: You start each fight with a shield equal to {p} of your max HP.
skills.m5: the first time you drop under 50% HP, the shield recharges

skills.name: Spiked Rivets
skills.desc: You return {p} of the damage you take (before Defense).
skills.m5: the returned damage ignores enemy Defense

skills.name: Brass Cuirass
skills.desc: +{v} Defense.

skills.name: Double Riveting
skills.desc: You take {p} less damage.

skills.name: Battering Ram
skills.desc: Every 4 turns you ram for {v}× your Defense + 60% of attack.

skills.name: Riveter
skills.desc: Your hits add {v}× your Defense as Rivet damage.

skills.name: Armored Bulkhead
skills.desc: Every 3 turns you gain a shield of {p} of your max HP, and your hits add 10% of your shield.

skills.name: Walking Fortress
skills.desc: Condition: 20+ Defense. You return {p} of the damage stopped by your Defense and your shield.

skills.name: Precision Monocle
skills.desc: +{p} crit chance.

skills.name: Brass Laser Pointer
skills.desc: +{p} Accuracy.

skills.name: Sharpened Teeth
skills.desc: Your hits deal +{p} damage.

skills.name: Twin Gear
skills.desc: {p} chance to hit twice.

skills.name: Fine Caliber
skills.desc: Accuracy above the enemy's Evasion adds {p} of that gap as crit chance.

skills.name: Shears
skills.desc: Your hits deal +{p} damage to enemies below 30% HP.

skills.name: Perfect Escapement
skills.desc: Condition: 40%+ crit chance. Your crits hit again at 50% and gain +{p} crit damage. With 4+ Escapement skills, every 6 turns you take 2 extra actions.

skills.name: Extra Wind
skills.desc: You gain {v} tempo per turn. At 100, you take an extra action.
skills.m3: you start each fight with 30 tempo

skills.name: Escapement Brake
skills.desc: {p} chance the enemy loses its turn.

skills.name: Pendulum
skills.desc: Every third hit deals +{p} damage.

skills.name: Stop Time
skills.desc: Once per fight, when you drop under 30% HP, the enemy loses {v} turn(s).

skills.name: Patch Plate
skills.desc: You repair {p} of your max HP each turn.

skills.name: Rust Vial
skills.desc: Every 3 turns, dump {v} rust on the enemy. It does not flake away.

skills.name: Rust Catalyst
skills.desc: Rust deals +{p} damage.

skills.name: Weld Bead
skills.desc: Repairs are +{p} stronger, and any overflow becomes shield.

skills.name: Tuning Fork
skills.desc: Each hit adds {v} resonance. At 10 it detonates for 180% of attack (ignores Defense).

skills.name: Shockwave
skills.desc: Every 3 turns, add {v} resonance (at 10, it detonates).

skills.name: Pipe Choir
skills.desc: Each turn you add {v} resonance.

skills.name: Vibrato
skills.desc: Each detonation grants +{p} Evasion for this fight (max 5 times).

skills.name: Bronze Bell
skills.desc: Detonations deal +{p} damage.

skills.name: Echo
skills.desc: After a detonation you keep {v} resonance.

skills.name: Breaking Frequency
skills.desc: Each detonation removes {v} Defense from the enemy for the rest of the fight.

skills.name: Perfect Harmonic
skills.desc: Detonation needs {v} less resonance.

skills.name: Impossible Note
skills.desc: Condition: after 4 detonations in a fight, detonations deal +{p} damage and stun for 1 turn.

skills.name: Clockwork Helper
skills.desc: An automaton hits each turn for {p} of your attack.
skills.m3: it can crit with your crit chance
skills.m5: a second helper joins at half strength

skills.name: Squire Automaton
skills.desc: A squire automaton takes {p} of the damage dealt to you.

skills.name: Precision Screws
skills.desc: Your automata have +{p} crit chance (they use your crit damage).

skills.name: Springs
skills.desc: Whenever you dodge, your automata hit again at {p}.

skills.name: Assembly Line
skills.desc: Every 4 turns you build a mini automaton (max 3) that hits each turn for {p} of your attack.

skills.name: Maintenance
skills.desc: Your automata deal +{p} damage.

skills.name: Shared Battery
skills.desc: Every 5 turns, each active automaton discharges {p} of attack.

skills.name: Steam Colossus
skills.desc: Every 6 turns a colossus stomps for {p} of attack and stuns for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tin Army
skills.desc: Condition: with 3 mini automata, they assemble into a Grand Automaton that hits each turn for {p} of attack and ignores Defense.

skills.name: Rusty File
skills.desc: Critical hits apply {v} rust.

skills.name: Corrosive Steam
skills.desc: Scald deals +{p} per point of rust (max 20).

skills.name: Ground Wire
skills.desc: When you are hit, {p} chance to answer with a discharge (80% of attack).

skills.name: Live Wire
skills.desc: Discharges deal +{p} damage.

skills.name: Resonant Coil
skills.desc: Each discharge adds {v} resonance.

skills.name: Steam Whistle
skills.desc: Each turn of scald adds {v} resonance.

skills.name: Recoil Spring
skills.desc: When you are hit, {p} chance to counter with your full attack.

skills.name: Scrap Golem
skills.desc: While you have automata, you gain a shield of {p} of your max HP each turn.

skills.name: Splice
skills.desc: You repair for {p} of the damage from your hits.

skills.name: Anchor Escapement
skills.desc: Extra actions always crit and gain +{p} crit damage.

skills.name: Synced Clocks
skills.desc: On each extra action, your automata strike again at {p}.

skills.name: Ringing Plate
skills.desc: Detonations deal +{p} damage.

skills.name: Repair Drones
skills.desc: Your automata repair you for {p} of the damage they deal.

skills.name: Steam Turbine
skills.desc: Your automata deal +{p} damage to scalded enemies.

skills.name: Armored Belfry
skills.desc: Each detonation grants a shield of {v}× your Defense, plus 3.

skills.name: Flaking
skills.desc: Each turn, add {v} rust. It never flakes away.

skills.name: Scale
skills.desc: Rust deals +{p} damage for every 10 rust on the enemy.

skills.name: Rust Bloom
skills.desc: At 16+ rust, every 4 turns a burst deals {p} of attack for each point of rust, ignoring Defense.

skills.name: Crackle
skills.desc: Each turn, {p} chance to fire a discharge (75% of attack).

skills.name: Aftershock
skills.desc: After a discharge, fire an extra shock for {p} of attack.

skills.name: Arc Cage
skills.desc: Every 4 turns, fire a discharge of {p} attack.

skills.name: Corona
skills.desc: Discharges ignore Defense and deal +{p} damage.

skills.name: Field Weld
skills.desc: The first time you drop under 40% HP, repair {p} of your max HP.

skills.name: Oil Film
skills.desc: You start each fight with a shield of {p} of your max HP.

skills.name: Seam Tape
skills.desc: At the start of each fight, repair {p} of your max HP.

skills.name: Scrap Hammer
skills.desc: Your hits deal extra damage equal to {p} of your attack plus the same share of your shield.

upgradeEffects.text: The hammer stroke also plates 4% of your max HP as shield at the start of a fight.
A second weld. The first effect holds, and attacks deal +3%.

skills.name: Scrap Cycle
skills.desc: Every 4 turns, repair {p} of your max HP.

skills.name: Scrap Plating
skills.desc: Each turn, gain a shield of {p} of your max HP.

skills.name: Kiln Rest
skills.desc: Every 5 turns, repair {p} of your max HP.

skills.name: Jury Hull
skills.desc: While you are under half HP, you take {p} less damage.

skills.name: Self-Forge
skills.desc: Condition: 4+ Salvage skills. Repairs are +{p} stronger, and 35% of the HP you actually restore also becomes shield.

gears.name: Grimy File
gears.desc: You start with Acid Drop. +5% rust damage.

gears.name: Homemade Coil
gears.desc: You start with Spark. +11% discharge damage.

gears.name: Patch Kit
gears.desc: You start with Scrap Hammer. Repairs are +12% stronger and hits deal +3% damage.

gears.name: Pocket Escapement
gears.desc: You start with Sharpened Teeth. +8% crit chance and +33% hit damage.

gears.name: Patched Teapot
gears.desc: You start with Steam Jet. +22% steam damage.

gears.name: Pot Lid
gears.desc: You start with Brass Cuirass. +2 Defense and +1% Rivet damage.

gears.name: Dented Tuning Fork
gears.desc: You start with Tuning Fork. +40% detonation damage.

gears.name: Clockwork Toy
gears.desc: You start with Clockwork Helper. +9% automaton damage.

traits.blindado: Armored: +25 Defense (rust, scald, and armor-piercing damage get through)

b_chispa.name: Opening Spark
b_chispa.text: Each fight starts with a discharge at 150% of attack

b_gracia.name: Second of Grace
b_gracia.text: The first enemy attack of each fight misses

k_deuda.name: Nut Debt
k_deuda.text: You earn half as many nuts

events.title: Statue of Two Faces
events.text: A brass statue with two faceplates blocks the path. It only lets through a chassis that chooses.

choices.label: Lion plate
choices.detail: +3 attack. Lose 15% of your current HP.

choices.label: Owl plate
choices.detail: +1 level to a random skill. -10 max HP.

events.title: Two Boiler Doors
events.text: One door burns red-hot. The other drips cool steam.

choices.label: Red door
choices.detail: Pick 1 of 3 rare or epic skills. Lose 20% of your current HP.

events.title: The Mechanical Judge's Scales
events.text: A tin judge demands you put something on the scale.

events.title: Giant Hourglass
events.text: The sand is copper filings. It falls very slowly.

events.title: Brass Mirror
events.text: Your reflection is wearing much better kit than you are.

events.title: Sleeping Golem
events.text: A scrap golem snores on a heap of parts.

choices.label: Wake it
choices.detail: An elite fight, with an elite reward.

events.title: Track Crossing
events.text: Two tram tracks. One runs to a workshop, the other to the market.

events.title: Unstable Boiler
events.text: The pressure needle is trembling in the red.

choices.label: Tighten the valve
choices.detail: 60%: +3 attack. 40%: lose 25% of your current HP.

events.title: Library of Blueprints
events.text: Shelves of rolled plans, sorted by family.

choices.label: Study your own trade
choices.detail: Pick 1 of 3 skills from your tool's family.

events.title: The Talking Lamp
events.text: The lamp will trade words, not nuts.

events.title: Shrine of the Great Gear
events.text: A toothed wheel the size of a house turns without a sound.

events.title: Shrine of the Steam Engine
events.text: A boiler-shaped engine wraps you in warm vapor and ticks a greeting.

events.title: Shrine of the Eternal Spark
events.text: A blue spark dances between two copper posts.

choices.label: Opening Spark
choices.detail: Each fight starts with a discharge at 150% of attack.

events.title: Shrine of the Rust Well
events.text: A rust-crusted chassis altar smells of rain and iron.

events.title: Shrine of the Stopped Clock
events.text: A bronze chassis sleeps beside a thousand stopped clocks.

choices.label: Second of Grace
choices.detail: The first enemy attack of each fight misses.

events.title: Council of the Engines
events.text: The five Patron Engines watch you at once. They offer a deal.

choices.label: Take the deal
choices.detail: Sharp Tooth (+10% attack) and a ward for -6% damage taken, but the curse Loose Cog.

events.title: Cursed Chest
events.text: The padlock is shaped like a gear-skull.

choices.label: Open it
choices.detail: Pick 1 of 3 epics. Curse: Loose Cog (enemies +8% attack).

events.title: Smoke Contract
events.text: A faceless chassis offers a contract written in soot.

choices.label: Sign it
choices.detail: +60 nuts. Curse: Rust in the Joints (+8% damage taken).

events.title: Enchanted Gas Mask
events.text: You see better through it. Your vents clog.

choices.label: Put it on
choices.detail: +10% crit chance. Curse: Stuck Valve (-5% healing after fights).

events.title: Forbidden Engine
events.text: A chained, sealed engine hums with force.

choices.label: Plug yourself in
choices.detail: +1 level to 2 skills. Curse: Crack in the Suit (-15 max HP).

events.title: Tin Crow
events.text: A mechanical crow offers a pact in a gramophone voice.

choices.label: Take the pact
choices.detail: +10% to all your damage. Curse: Soot in the Eyes (-4% crit chance).

events.title: Black Oil
events.text: A barrel of thick oil shines with purple highlights.

choices.label: Drink it
choices.detail: +4 attack. Curse: Nut Debt (you earn half as many nuts).

events.title: Traveling Scrapper
events.text: The scrap-frame's cart is shut. It points you toward the merchant and shares a sip of oil.

events.title: Traveling Clockwork
events.text: Its case stays closed. It still lets you sit a minute.

events.title: Canal Apothecary
events.text: The flasks stay in the boat. The smell alone is a little soothing.

events.title: Blueprint Auction
events.text: The gavel is for other buyers. You can still sell one of your own plans.

choices.label: Sell one of your plans
choices.detail: -1 level to a random skill. +45 nuts.

events.title: Black Market
events.text: It will not take nuts. A favor, or nothing.

choices.label: Call in a favor
choices.detail: Lose 12% of your current HP. Lose a random curse, if you have one.

events.title: Traveling Smith
events.text: The forge is banked. It lets you warm your joints. Nothing is for sale.

events.title: Brass Tailor
events.text: It has no cloth for sale. It does pin a spare ribbon on your coat.

events.title: Fairground Optician
events.text: The lenses are only for show today. You may still borrow a look.

events.title: Inventors' Fair
events.text: The stalls are shouting, but nobody is selling to you. A vendor presses a few nuts into your hand to move you along.

events.title: Training Automaton
events.text: A spring-loaded dummy offers to train with you. It hits for real.

choices.label: Train your attack
choices.detail: +1 attack. Lose 15% of your current HP.

choices.label: Brace your guard
choices.detail: +3 Defense. Lose 12% of your current HP.

events.title: Forgotten Manuals
events.text: Two brass-bound manuals stick out of a trash bin.

events.title: Boiler Weights
events.text: Someone left a set of weights made from old boilers.

choices.label: Lift them
choices.detail: 60%: +2 attack. 40%: lose 20% of your current HP.

events.title: Steam Slot Machine
events.text: The slot takes no nuts from you. Kick it, or give the crank one free pull.

choices.label: Give it a kick
choices.detail: 50%: +15 nuts. 50%: lose 10% of your current HP.

events.title: Gear Wheel
events.text: An abandoned fair. The wheel still spins if you push it.

choices.label: Spin it
choices.detail: 50%: +1 level to 2 skills. 50%: -1 level to one skill.

events.title: Copper Dice
events.text: The dice-frame will not take nuts. It will still throw for pride.

events.title: Jack-in-the-Box
events.text: A little tune plays. Something is moving inside.

choices.label: Turn the crank
choices.detail: 70%: pick 1 of 3 skills. 30%: an enemy pops out (a fight).

events.title: Clockwork Mouse Race
events.text: No bookie. Cheer a mouse, or just watch.

events.title: Trapped Machinist
events.text: A beam has fallen across a machinist unit.

choices.label: Lift the beam
choices.detail: Lose 15% of your current HP. They teach you a trick: +1 level to 2 skills.

events.title: Lost Clockwork
events.text: A small clockwork cannot find its berth.

events.title: Broken Automaton
events.text: A small automaton keeps trying to stand up.

events.title: Chimney Drone
events.text: A small flier ticks and sparks at the top of a chimney.

choices.label: Climb up for it
choices.detail: 50%: +8% crit chance (the flier brings luck). 50%: lose 10% of your current HP.

events.title: Airship in Trouble
events.text: Raiders are attacking a moored airship.

choices.label: Defend the airship
choices.detail: An elite fight, an elite reward, and +30 nuts.

events.title: Toolbox
events.text: A forgotten box under a workshop bench.

events.title: Copper Vein
events.text: A broken wall shows pure copper.

choices.label: Dig
choices.detail: +40 nuts. Lose 10% of your current HP.

events.title: Chassis Chest
events.text: An airship chassis chest, still shut.

choices.label: Force it
choices.detail: Pick 1 of 3 rare or epic skills.

events.title: Golden Blueprint
events.text: A plan stamped by the Great Engine.

choices.label: Study it
choices.detail: +1 level to every skill you have in your tool's family.

events.title: Lukewarm Tap
events.text: A brass tap drips warm water in an alley.

events.title: The Smith's Anvil
events.text: The anvil is still hot. A hammer is waiting.

choices.label: Reforge
choices.detail: Lose a random skill and gain 2 levels split across the others.

events.title: Transmutation Alembic
events.text: A liquid that keeps changing color is bubbling away.

choices.label: Transmute
choices.detail: A random skill becomes a skill from another family, at the same level.

events.title: Altar of the Great Gear
events.text: A giant toothed wheel asks for an offering.

choices.label: Wind the key
choices.detail: Lose 20% of your current HP. +3 attack.

events.title: Test Bench
events.text: Clamps, cables, and one enormous red button.

choices.label: Overcharge
choices.detail: +1 level to your best skill and to another at random. -15 max HP.

events.title: Melting Crucible
events.text: Molten metal could join two pieces into a better one.

choices.label: Melt two into one
choices.detail: Lose your 2 lowest-level skills, then pick 1 of 3 epics.

events.title: Alley Ambush
events.text: Eyes gleam between the trash bins.

choices.label: Fight
choices.detail: A normal fight, its reward, and +20 nuts.

events.title: Automaton Duel
events.text: A champion of mechanical duels wants a rival.

choices.label: Accept
choices.detail: An elite fight, with an elite reward.

events.title: Echo in the Pipes
events.text: Something repeats your footsteps inside the tubes.

camp.title: Camp
camp.text: A quiet coal stove. Rest, or tune a skill. Nuts are only spent at the merchant.

merchant.title: Wandering merchant
merchant.intro: Nuts are spent only here. Buy up to 3 stat upgrades, and one skill. Pay to refresh the stock, or leave the nuts for the next stall.

tiers.name: Early stock
tiers.blurb: Small upgrades. Common and rare skills.

tiers.name: Late stock
tiers.blurb: Larger upgrades. Rare, epic, and legendary skills.

statInfo.name: Attack
statInfo.tip: The base of almost all your damage.

statInfo.name: Evasion
statInfo.tip: Subtracts from the enemy's hit chance (base 95%).

statInfo.name: Accuracy
statInfo.tip: Adds to your hit chance (base 95%) and counters enemy Evasion.

effects.note: Earlier path. Each rank unlocks upgradeEffects[rank-1] on that skill: a text line plus optional mods.

startLevel.note: Late path. The skill is offered already at level 1+rank, capped at its rarity max. Few ranks, steep costs, gated behind scrap earned, chassis, and tools.
